body.value:
FIT_101(
    Scaling_Slope := 62.5,
    Scaling_Offset := -250.0,
    Alarm_Enable := TRUE);
FIT_102(
    Alarm_Enable := TRUE);
AT_105(
    Bool_In := AT105_Permissive,
    Alarm_OnTrue := FALSE,
    Alarm_OnFalse := TRUE,
    Latch_Enable := TRUE);
LV103_Permissive_NOT := NOT LV103_Permissive;
MasterInhibit_OR := FIT_101.Low_Alarm OR FIT_101.General_Fault OR AT_105.Alarm_Active OR LV103_Permissive_NOT;
FIC_104(
    Auto := TRUE,
    PrimaryPV := FIT_101.PV,
    SecondaryPV := FIT_102.PV,
    RatioSP := 0.1,
    MV_MIN := 0.0,
    MV_MAX := 200.0,
    Inhibit := MasterInhibit_OR);
FIC_104_SLAVE(
    AUTO := TRUE,
    PV := FIT_102.PV,
    SP := FIC_104.SlaveSP,
    MV_MIN := 0.0,
    MV_MAX := 100.0,
    X0 := 0.0,
    KP := 1.0,
    TR := 10.0,
    TD := 0.0,
    Deviation_Limit := 20.0,
    Inhibit := MasterInhibit_OR);
FV_102(
    Control_Signal := FIC_104_SLAVE.XOUT,
    Manual_Mode := FALSE,
    Open_Limit := 100.0,
    Close_Limit := 0.0,
    Inhibit := MasterInhibit_OR);

(* Outputs published to other sections / HMI. *)
FIT101_BypassFlow_PV := FIT_101.PV;
FIT102_SamplingFlow_PV := FIT_102.PV;
FIC104_SamplingFlow_SP := FIC_104.SlaveSP;
FIC104_ActiveRatio := FIC_104.ActiveRatio;

(* Entry point required by OpenPLC Editor v4. The process sections run as parallel program instances under task0; main only provides a scan heartbeat. *)
Heartbeat := NOT Heartbeat;
